programs.description: Kochuvava, a young boy, witnesses the murder of his father by a feared landlord of their village. He grows up to be a ruthless businessman hell-bent on taking revenge on the culprits.
After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.
Bobby, a college student, mistakes another student named Malavika for an unknown girl who is sending romantic notes to him. Under this impression, he tries to win her heart.
A prince sets out on a hunt to find the diamonds that belonged to his ancestors. He faces challenges when he encounters several frauds who try to mislead him.
Ambu, a carefree college student, falls in love with a woman he sees at a bus stop. However, before he can confess his feelings, unexpected complications arise.

Reshmi, the wife of a young political leader, Mohan Kumar, commits suicide just when he is gearing up for a by-election. An inquiry team led by Shyam Prasad is tasked to find out the reason behind it.
Immanuel's life takes an odd turn when the publishing firm that he works for shuts down. He gets a job in an insurance company but faces severe hardships, which end up changing him as a person.
Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.
After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
Religious intolerance in a small faction results in a communal riot. A Muslim father is torn apart when his daughter requests him to marry her off to her Hindu lover.
Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.
Sandeep, a doctor, befriends Devan, a patient with an incurable illness. He decides to make his last days count by doing something memorable.
While Benny encounters the love of his life Reena, elsewhere, Deepak gets close to Arathy with bad intentions. Subsequently, their lives intersect when a criminal act takes place.
A man borrows money to go to Dubai and assures his moneylenders visas and jobs in return. Instead, he vanishes and promises to reopen a mill that has been shut down when they demand their money back.
Menon takes the help of a dangerous prisoner, Vikraman, who resembles a policeman, in order to nab a notorious gangster.
Amarnath, a police officer, tries to settle a communal riot that has taken place among the fishermen. However, he faces many challenges as he strives to bring the criminals to justice.
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.
Kunjulakshmi, pampered by her brothers, is somewhat arrogant. When she falsely accuses Sivashankaran, a peon, of misbehaving with her, he decides to teach her a lesson.
Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
Passenger
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
An unexpected event on the day of their granddaughter's engagement leads a nonagenarian couple on a journey that tests their familial bonds.
Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.
Kumaran and Lakshmi, hailing from varying social backgrounds, get romantically involved, defying societal norms. Later, Lakshmi's father attempts to sever their relationship.
Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.
Devan, an orphan, drinks an invisibility potion and sets out to rescue Maya, a journalist who is raising him, after she is kidnapped by an influential man.
